say:1:1910835001:1.text: What do you mean "sun"? What is that? Why is it so hot? It's hotter than an undersea volcano...
say:1:1910835001:1.source_cn: 太阳……到底是什么？为什么会那么烫，比海底火山还要烫？

say:2:1910835002:1.text: How bright are the sun and moon? Are they brighter than Grandma's favorite pearl?
say:2:1910835002:1.source_cn: 太阳和月亮，到底有多亮？比阿嬷最喜欢的那颗蚌珠……还亮吗？

say:3:1910835003:1.text: We can't see the sun or the moon, though... Does that mean we have to leave the sea in order to see and touch them?
say:3:1910835003:1.source_cn: 我们看不到太阳和月亮……是不是只有离开海，才能看到、摸...

say:4:1910835004:1.text: But leaving the sea is scary...
say:4:1910835004:1.source_cn: 可离开海，实在太可怕了……

say:5:1910835005:1.text: That's right. Coralia is where we belong. It's the safest and most beautiful place there is.
say:5:1910835005:1.source_cn: 是呀，塔拉萨才是我们应该在的地方，这里最安全、最美好。

say:6:1910835006:1.text: As long as we're together, we have nothing to fear.
say:6:1910835006:1.source_cn: 只要大家在一起，我们就什么都不害怕。

say:7:1910835007:1.text: Nothing to fear... nothing to fear...
say:7:1910835007:1.source_cn: 什么都不害怕，什么都不害怕……

say:9:1910835008:1.text: Grandma, have something to eat. There's fresh shrimp cured in coral salt and algae paste. Then, we can have sweet seagrass pie for later.
say:9:1910835008:1.source_cn: 阿嬷，你也来吃点吧，用珊瑚盐、黑藻酱和香叶草腌制的鲜虾...

say:10:1910835009:1.source_cn: 小沫霖，阿嬷觉得……好像少了什么人。

say:11:1910835010:1.text: Morin, I feel like... someone is missing...
say:11:1910835010:1.source_cn: 嘘，嘘……晚餐是一天最重要的时间哦，只能和家人一起享用...

say:12:1910835011:1.text: Shush now... Dinner is the most important time of the day. You can only share it with your family, and you're all so important to me.
say:12:1910835011:1.source_cn: 我们以后永远在一起，永远也不会分开。

say:14:1910835012:1.text: From now on, we'll be together forever and never be apart.

say:17:1910835015:1.source_cn: 安宁地享用吧，亲爱的我，和睦的碎片。

say:18:1910835016:1.source_cn: 不必担心还未归家的孩子……她很快就会回来。与我们……<...

say:20:1910835017:1.text: Eat in peace, my dears... my happy fragments...

say:21:1910835018:1.text: Don't worry about the child who hasn't come home yet. She will be back soon... with us... <style="highlight2">as one</style>...
say:21:1910835018:1.source_cn: 沫霖姐，快醒来！不要被她控制啊！

say:23:1910835020:1.text: Morin, wake up! Don't let her control you!
say:23:1910835020:1.source_cn: 该死……阿嬷，快醒醒……你肯定能听到咱说话，你肯定记得...

say:24:1910835021:1.source_cn: 阿嬷，咱……咱还想再吃你做的香腌虾……坚持住，不要忘记...

say:25:1910835022:1.text: Damn it! Grandma, wake up! I know you hear me! You remember that dinner, right? You said you went to the trouble of preparing forty spiced shrimp just for us...
say:25:1910835022:1.source_cn: 艾菲拉……她还在拼了命地努力，想带你们回家。快醒过来，...

say:26:1910835023:1.text: I still wanna eat your shrimp again. So please, hold on. Don't forget us! Don't forget yourself!

say:27:1910835024:1.text: Elphira is still fighting with everything she has! She's trying to bring you all home! So wake up and go home with her!
say:27:1910835024:1.source_cn: 老大，你看啊！阿嬷，阿嬷她还记得……！

say:28:1910835025:1.source_cn: 咱到底要怎么做……只要能把他们带回来，咱什么都愿意做……

say:29:1910835026:1.source_cn: 你看得很清楚，在那个瞬间，摩淖亚曾短暂地抵挡住了奥汐娜...

say:30:1910835027:1.text: Damn it, what do we have to do...? I'd do anything to bring them all back...
say:30:1910835027:1.male: Damn it, what do we have to do...? I'd do anything to bring them all back...
say:30:1910835027:1.female: Damn it, what do we have to do...? I'd do anything to bring them all back...

say:31:1910835028:1.text: You saw it clearly. Grandma Menoa managed to resist Oceana's control, if only for a moment. A miracle that had never happened before...
say:31:1910835028:1.source_cn: 而引发这个小小奇迹的，正是那个正在不断努力成长的光球…...
say:31:1910835028:1.male: You saw it clearly. Grandma Menoa managed to resist Oceana's control, if only for a moment. A miracle that had never happened before...
say:31:1910835028:1.female: You saw it clearly. Grandma Menoa managed to resist Oceana's control, if only for a moment. A miracle that had never happened before...

choice_prompt:32:1910835028.female: You saw it clearly. Grandma Menoa managed to resist Oceana's control, if only for a moment. A miracle that had never happened before...

say:33:1910835029:1.source_cn: 这样做，就能把大家带回来？

choice_prompt:34:1910835029.source_cn: 这样做，就能把大家带回来？

say:35:1910835030:1.text: And what triggered this small miracle was that orb that's still fighting to grow. It's Elphira's consciousness!
say:35:1910835030:1.male: And what triggered this small miracle was that orb that's still fighting to grow. It's Elphira's consciousness!
say:35:1910835030:1.female: And what triggered this small miracle was that orb that's still fighting to grow. It's Elphira's consciousness!

choice:32:0:1.text: We have to make Elphira's consciousness whole.
choice:32:0:1.source_cn: 把艾菲拉的意识拼凑完整！
choice:32:0:1.male: We have to make Elphira's consciousness whole.
choice:32:0:1.female: We have to make Elphira's consciousness whole.

choice:32:1:2.text: Her mind needs to be strong enough to withstand Oceana.
choice:32:1:2.source_cn: 让艾菲拉的意识能与奥汐娜抗衡！
